latestVersion.changelog:
AI Voiceover App — Add Voiceovers to Videos v1.0.0

- Initial release with support for adding AI-generated voiceovers to videos or scripts (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB).
- Simple authentication via free token (100 credits, 7-day validity) issued automatically on first use.
- Upload videos/scripts, generate natural AI voiceovers, and export high-quality 1080p MP4s within 30-60 seconds.
- Supports workflow actions: upload, preview, credits check, export, and iterative editing.
- Error handling for token, session, credits, file type, and rate limiting with clear user feedback.
- Cloud-based GPU rendering—no installation required; all major video/audio/image formats accepted.
